title: Lululemon’s Rare Sale Is Live With Align Pants, ABC Trousers & Summer Styles From $19
summary: The high-end activewear brand seen on musicians like Kelsea Ballerini rarely goes on sale, but shoppers can now score hundreds of Lululemon favorites for up to 65% off.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes. Lululemon rarely discounts its most popular styles , but the brand’s latest Summer Sale is changing that. For a limited time, shoppers can score hundreds of deals across the brand’s activewear lineup, including fan-favorite leggings, workout tops, shorts and accessories starting at just $19. Shop Lululemon Summer Sale Unlike Lululemon’s We Made Too Much section , which offers discounted styles year-round and receives drops of close-out or discontinued merch every Thursday, this rare sale includes some of the brand’s most in-demand pieces. Shoppers can finally score viral favorites like the Align Pants with pockets and the bestselling ABC Trousers at a lower price than normal. The ABC Trousers have become a cult favorite thanks to their comfortable design and signature “anti-ball crushing” technology, which uses an ergonomic gusset to help reduce tension and provide a more comfortable fit. Meanwhile, the Align Pants remain one of Lululemon’s most popular leggings, known for their buttery-soft feel and versatile design. With select items up to 65% off, Lululemon’s Summer Sale is a rare opportunity to shop the brand’s best-selling activewear for less. From workout essentials to everyday staples, these deals are worth browsing before popular sizes and styles sell out. VIRAL PICK Align High Rise Pants $59 $98 40% off Buy Now at lululemon Buttery-soft leggings with a hidden waistband pocket. The Lululemon Align Pants are one of the brand’s best-selling leggings for a reason. The viral style features a buttery-soft feel that shoppers love, plus a wide waistband for comfortable coverage that won’t dig into your waist. It also includes a hidden pocket inside the waistband where you can safely store small essentials like keys or cards while on the go. Available in 25-inch, 28-inch and 31-inch lengths, the Align Pants are now included in Lululemon’s 2026 Summer Sale, with select colors starting at $59 and going up to $89. More reasons to love — and live — in these leggings? Country star Kelsea Ballerini is an official Lululemon ambassador and starred in a campaign promoting her favorite Align styles. MAXIMUM COMFORT Pace Breaker Linerless Short $39 $68 43% off Sweat-wicking shorts designed for running and training. These athlete-backed Lululemon shorts are designed for both workouts and everyday wear, thanks to their lightweight, quick-drying fabric and breathable construction. The style features a grid mesh inner waistband and mesh fabric at the back yoke to help provide extra ventilation, while the streamlined fit gives your glutes and thighs room to move. Plus, four-way stretch technology delivers added comfort and flexibility with every step. Lewis Hamilton is another Lululemon ambassador and a fan of these shorts. YEAR-ROUND FAVORITE Structured Classic Ball Cap Script $19 $29 34% off A classic always-in-style ball cap with a script logo. Made from structured cotton twill fabric that’s soft and breathable, this crisp white ball cap with vibrant blue script detailing is a year-round accessory you’ll want to shop for just $19. An interior moisture-wicking sweatband helps keep sweat at bay, while the adjustable back closure neatly tucks into a hidden pocket for a sleeker, more streamlined look. Y2K STAPLE Organic Cotton Baby Tee $34 $48 29% off A 90s-inspired tee made from organic cotton jersey. In case you haven’t heard, the 90s are back , and this baby tee is quickly becoming a capsule wardrobe staple. The fitted style features four-way stretch with added Lycra fiber to help maintain its shape while offering a comfortable, flexible fit. Made from organic cotton, it’s naturally breathable and lightweight enough for everyday wear. The silhouette hits just above the waist and contours to your body for a flattering fit that makes it easy to style with everything from low-rise jeans to leggings. SELL-OUT RISK ABC Slim Fit Trouser $69 $138 50% off Sweat-wicking pants with ABC (Anti-Ball-Crushing) technology. The men’s ABC Trousers quickly became another Lululemon best-seller thanks to their unique ergonomic gusset, which is designed to reduce tension in the crotch area for a more comfortable fit. Made from a breathable fabric with four-way stretch, these versatile trousers offer easy movement while featuring a discreet zippered pocket along the side seam to safely store small essentials. TWO-IN-ONE ACCESSORY Dual Pouch Wristlet $39 $48 19% off A cherry red wristlet with two zipper pouches, perfect for storing ID, keys and makeup. For those always on the go, the Lululemon wristlet is a convenient way to store your everyday essentials. It features two zippered pouches, with each compartment measuring 4.5″ x 0.2″ x 2.8″ to help keep small items organized. The pouches are also detachable, allowing them to be used separately as a standalone wallet when you only need to carry the essentials. COMFORTABLE FIT Shake It Out High-Rise Running Short $24 $68 65% off A sweat-wicking running short with a relaxed fit, made from 100% recycled polyester. With a built-in liner for added coverage and a hidden card pocket, these quick-drying shorts are designed for running and everyday movement. The lightweight style features added stretch for a comfortable fit, while shoppers praise the flattering length and silhouette that helps create the appearance of curves on athletic figures. Available for just $24, these versatile shorts are a standout deal. LOW-IMPACT ESSENTIAL Nulu Ribbed Scoop-Neck Bra Light Support $49 $58 16% off A light support workout yoga bra made from lululemon’s soft ribbed Nulu fabric. This fuss-free yoga bra features a classic scoopneck design that’s made for both on and off the mat. Designed for B/C cups and low-impact activities, the style offers a comfortable fit with a soft, brushed underband for added support. It also features a sweat-wicking, four-way stretch liner that helps keep you comfortable through every activity. GAME-DAY READY Checkerboard Satin Linerless Gym Short $49 $78 37% off Seven-inch gym shorts designed for intensive training. These satin black shorts were made for movement, thanks to their sweat-wicking and quick-drying fabric designed to help keep you comfortable during activity. The style features a roomy fit through the glutes and thighs, along with a strategically placed gusset that allows for increased mobility. Side splits at the hem provide added ease of movement, making them a versatile choice for workouts, sports and everyday wear. LUXE LOOK FOR LESS Quilty Pleasures Shoulder Bag
Mini 5L $39 $98 60% off And I love this Lululemon shoulder bag, which features a quilted design that’s as stylish as it is practical. The shoulder bag is roomy enough to fit up to a 13-inch laptop but compact enough to double as an accessible everyday carry. The quilted nylon lends a sporty look and feel to the classic sling bag silhouette. The material is water-resistant too, so you don’t have to worry if you’re accidentally caught out in the rain. An adjustable shoulder strap lets you carry this bag tight under the arm, low and slouchy, or as a tote. Lululemon’s collection of bags have become as popular as its apparel in recent years and this is a chance to score a discount on a trending style. Lululemon’s popularity extends far beyond workout studios, with the brand becoming a favorite among athletes, musicians and celebrities.
